title: Steel Structures in Jacó: Roofs & Carports | MA Soluciones
description: Steel structures in Jacó: roofs, carports, canopies and reinforcements in galvanized steel, designed for coastal conditions. 48 h quotes.
h1: Steel Structures in Jacó, Costa Rica
lead: We fabricate and install steel structures in Jacó: roofs, carports, canopies and extensions in galvanized steel, designed for coastal winds, salt corrosion and Central Pacific rain loads.
heroAlt: Steel roof structure in Jacó, Costa Rica
highlightsTitle: Structures that resist wind and salt

highlights.title: Galvanized steel
highlights.text: Profiles and sheets with anti-corrosion protection — essential meters from the Pacific Ocean.

highlights.title: Coastal wind design
highlights.text: Anchor and span calculations that account for Pacific winds and rainy seasons.

highlights.title: Carports and canopies
highlights.text: Roofed extensions for vehicles, storage and service areas for villas and businesses in Jacó.

zoneLinkText: Jacó is the tourist and residential hub of the Central Pacific, between Garabito, Herradura and Playa Hermosa. We serve the area from our local base.

faqs.q: Do you design and build the structure?
faqs.a: Yes. We handle structural design, fabrication and installation, with drawings and calculation reports when the project requires them.

faqs.q: Can you reinforce an existing roof?
faqs.a: Yes. We assess the current structure and propose reinforcements or sheet replacement based on condition and needs.

faqs.q: How long does a carport take?
faqs.a: It depends on size, but most residential carports are installed within 1 to 3 weeks after design approval.
